physicalNotes: Radius 0.44 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Murgas et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2095 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract): 306,108 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.44 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Murgas et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2095 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3759 +/- 87 K from Murgas et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2095 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A.182M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
